name: claude-brief (Agent Briefing Digest)
description: Pick up exactly where your agents left off. Instant digest of everything Claude did since you last checked.
author: Jake

deliveryTo.description: Recipient ID for the delivery channel (chat ID, phone number, channel ID)

botToken.description: Optional: direct Telegram bot token (bypasses OpenClaw channel bridge)

schedule.description: Cron expression for scheduled delivery. Default: 8am weekdays. Set to empty string to disable scheduled delivery.

lookbackHours.description: Hours to look back. 0 = since last brief (recommended).

workspacePaths.description: Workspace paths to scan. Empty = all projects.
